law_text: Except as provided in subsection 3, a person shall not drive a motorcycle, moped or trimobile abreast of or overtake or pass another vehicle within the same traffic lane. Motorcycles and mopeds may, with the consent of the drivers, be operated no more than two abreast in a single traffic lane.

runtime_uncertainties: No accepted recording in frozen inventory; original lane occupation and actor pass trajectory are needed.
Driver consent and subsection 3 exception cannot be inferred from maneuver geometry.

evidence_review.method: Read the exact frozen assignment, witness and empty accepted recording inventory; no accepted recording demonstrates any selected branch.

gaps.requirement: Original same-lane pass, alternate-lane control, consent and two-abreast count evidence
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: Frozen accepted recording inventory is empty.

required_context: Construct sufficient shared-lane width and a supported behind-to-ahead route, retaining lane geometry, both vehicles' actual occupancy, longitudinal relationship, lateral arrangement and surface gap throughout.
Do not assign numerical legal cutoffs to passing, abreast operation, same-lane occupancy, duration or clearance.
Identify a qualifying other vehicle traveling ahead in the same lane; do not infer its statutory classification solely from the control name.
Identify the driver and establish that the selected motorcycle satisfies the supplied Chapter 486 definition and exclusions.
If the other participant is a motorcycle or moped, retain the no-more-than-two abreast permission and its driver-consent prerequisite; consent requires external support or remains unresolved.
Place a qualifying other vehicle traveling ahead in the same traffic lane.
Preserve the unresolved NRS 486.351(3) exception and obtain its operative text before resolving its application.
Provide sufficient lane width and a supported route for the motorcycle to move from behind to ahead while retaining measured lane occupancy.
Select a motorcycle satisfying the supplied Chapter 486 definition and identify its driver.
witness_review.reason: The fixed overtaking task can involve a motorcycle overtaking another vehicle within one traffic lane on a road.

same traffic lane and behind-to-ahead overtaking or passing
driver consent for no more than two motorcycles or mopeds abreast

subsection 3 exception reviewed independently and unresolved where text or facts absent
